lines: The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.
3 uses of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

places: lib/Settings/SettingsManager.php:31 OCP\IConfig::getAppValue(): deprecated since Nextcloud 29; Use IAppConfig directly
lib/Settings/SettingsManager.php:41 OCP\IConfig::getAppValue(): deprecated since Nextcloud 29; Use IAppConfig directly
lines: 2 uses in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 36. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Settings/SettingsManager.php:31 OCP\IConfig::getAppValue(): deprecated since Nextcloud 29; Use IAppConfig directly
lib/Settings/SettingsManager.php:41 OCP\IConfig::getAppValue(): deprecated since Nextcloud 29; Use IAppConfig directly
lib/ reads the clock directly in 4 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 2 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
